user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
Verta has five dispute reason codes. Each has a window, counted in days from the transaction date, after which a dispute can no longer be opened:

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

I can't tell you which code applies to TX-0401 from its ID and amount alone. The code depends on what happened with the payment. For example:

- **duplicate_charge**: you were charged more than once for the same purchase.
- **fraud_card_not_present**: you didn't authorise an online or card-not-present payment.
- **goods_not_received**: you paid, but the goods never arrived.
- **service_not_rendered**: you paid, but the service was not provided.
- **unauthorized_debit**: a debit was taken from your account without your authorisation.

Tell me what happened with the EUR 240.00 payment and I'll pick the matching code. I'll also check the dispute window and eligibility before anything is filed. Please confirm which account the transaction belongs to if you have more than one.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
